name: 検索順位と支払いの関係を説明する閉じられる案内
prompt:
Create one polished, faithful Japanese mobile information card for catalog ID LH01-0135, “検索順位と支払いの関係を説明する閉じられる案内”. Use the original Booking.com screen and exact crop for the card boundary, outline, close-control placement and compact callout anatomy. Use the Japanese mock for the exact localized copy and its Japanese line wrapping. The approved green reference only informs restrained accent color; do not copy its marker or heading.

Render one isolated white callout card close to 390x126 proportion. No surrounding results screen, phone frame, status bar, unrelated content, title heading, or button. Use a thin pale neutral border, white fill, subtle 12 px corners, and no noticeable shadow. Place one quiet dark X close control in the upper-right corner. Place the body copy at the left with comfortable compact padding and wrap to two lines. Place the separate link below it, aligned to the left.

Use exactly this Japanese copy, with no extra words:
施設からの支払いが表示順に影響する場合があります。
詳しく見る

Use Meiryo Regular 14 px / 24 px for the explanatory text, Metadata 12 px / 16 px for the link, and tracking 0. Use ink #1D1D1D, white #FFFFFF, a very light neutral-gray outline, and Lighthouse Brand green #1F6444 for the link. Keep the link underlined so its action remains recognizable without relying only on color. Adapt the source’s blue link to green while preserving its clear link treatment. Preserve the meaning exactly; do not imply that every property pays or that payment always changes ranking. Keep the card calm, readable, and compact, with no extra icons or decoration beyond the close X.
reviewNotes: Agent visual review: the exact Japanese explanatory copy and 詳しく見る link are present. The card has a white surface, fine border, upper-right close control, green underlined link and compact two-line copy. The Japanese wrap point differs slightly from the saved mock but remains complete and natural. Exact Meiryo metrics cannot be verified from the raster. Candidate only; no owner approval, editable-source or implementation claim.
